criteria.description: States the decision clearly and crisply.
Captures the reasoning / WHY behind the decision, not just the outcome.
Records the alternatives that were considered (e.g. ship Android anyway, split the team) and why they were rejected.
Notes how reversible the decision is (one-way vs two-way door) or how costly it would be to change course.
Identifies who made the decision and when.
States the assumptions or conditions under which the decision should be revisited.
